info_minus_track_start_seconds.note: INFO.date is ~1 hour after the first TRACK timestamp for matched sessions; event times use TRACK.

anonymisation: SHA-256 prefix of salt|value; original user names and session ids omitted from the CSV.

typing_speed_kpm.unit: WPM from keydown count / 5 chars-per-word over burst typing seconds (live logger convention). Not keys/min.

backspace_rate.unit: Backspace keydowns (keyCode 8) / keydowns in the window.

mean_key_interval_ms.unit: 60000 / typing_speed_kpm, matching live/training name. Not the raw mean inter-keydown ms.

std_key_interval_ms.unit: pstdev of inter-keydown gaps <= TYPING_PAUSE_MS. Training used a Monkeytype consistency proxy.

mouse_distance_px.unit: clustered mouse speed * 60 (one-minute equivalent), matching live snapshot, not raw path pixels.

mouse_speed_px_per_sec.unit: significant mousemove path / clustered active seconds (gaps <= 0.5s, step >= 3px).

mean_click_latency_ms.unit: mean mousemove→mousedown interval among gestures <= 420ms. NaN if none.

idle_time_sec.unit: max in-window gap among keydown/mousemove/mousedown, capped at 30s.

session_minutes.unit: minutes from episode start to window end (wall clock), not a rate.

definition_mismatches_vs_hybrid_training: typing_speed_kpm stores Monkeytype-style WPM, not keys per minute; EVTRACK uses keydown count.
mean_key_interval_ms is 60000/WPM (live/training name), not the arithmetic mean of inter-key ms.
std_key_interval_ms is burst inter-keydown pstdev; the hybrid training set used (100-consistency)×noise.
mouse/click/idle/session in behavior_final_dataset.csv were sampled from a synthetic fatigue label, not telemetry.
mean_click_latency_ms here is mousemove→mousedown ≤420ms. Training used a label-conditioned uniform draw.
Backspace is DOM keyCode 8 only. Codes 14/42/67/111 appear in TRACK but are not counted as Backspace.
keydown key=0 is retained as an anonymous keystroke (no character) and is not Backspace.
Clicks use mousedown. mouseup is fewer (incomplete pairs) and is not counted as a second click.
mouseover/mouseout/mousewheel are not used for distance, click rate, or idle.
INFO.ua / screen sizes are not behaviour features and are not copied to the window CSV.

unavailable.typed_text: Never present: TRACK.key is numeric keyCode, not a character. Not stored.
unavailable.fatigue_label: Not in EVTRACKINFO or EVTRACKTRACK. Not inferred.
unavailable.true_reaction_time: No stimulus timestamps. Click latency is last mousemove→mousedown only.
